what: The proposed canonical topology value `4 specialists per vendor (Cursor + Codex)` contains parentheses, but the topology generator rejects display values outside `[A-Za-z0-9 ./+-]`.
scenario_or_breakage: After updating `skills/shared/topology.tsv`, `bash scripts/generate-topology-docs.sh --check` fails before docs regeneration, blocking the PR.

what: The plan does not explicitly update all operator-facing waterfall prose that currently says every `/review` slot gets Phase 2 alternate-tool and Phase 3 Claude fallback.

what: The proposed topology update keeps a Step 5 panel row while the generator prose/contract says Step 5 phrases are excluded from the topology projection and owned only by quick-mode docs sync.
